# Documentation platform history

This independent four-part history starts with the adoption of platform
versions. Earlier documentation changes have no retroactive platform version.

## 0.3.2.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Document explicit media goals, local text comparison prerequisites
and optional method references. Align shared review guidance with schema 4
and clarify the scope of declared completion and recomputed review tasks.

Threat impact: Distinguish declared inputs and method assignments from verified
files or executed work. Preserve dated historical validation results.

Sovereignty impact: Keep methods portable and planning local, without selecting
a provider or authorizing external collection or transmission.

Validation: Documentation and package checks accompany synthetic planner,
CLI and MCP tests. User and model quality trials remain separate.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.3.1.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Refresh the English and French product overviews around concrete
investigation outcomes, traceable findings, local control and portable reports.
Make the public-export demo prominent and align user guides, schema descriptions,
MCP counts and dated validation records with the current source capabilities.

Threat impact: Keep stored subtitle checks distinct from audio verification,
capture indexes distinct from page content, and helper checks distinct from
model quality. Preserve historical test scope and sharing limitations.

Sovereignty impact: Clarify free Apache-2.0 software, independently selected
clients/models, optional external tools and offline helpers without implying
that a remote assistant becomes local.

Validation: Documentation links, source/package consistency and existing tests
are checked locally. No runtime behavior or provider configuration changes.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.3.0.0 - 2026-10-26

Summary: Document local public-export and timed-transcript imports, accepted
input shapes, precise source references and complete cue citation boundaries.
Provide executable recipes and a synthetic offline demonstration.

Threat impact: Distinguish archive indexes from captures, publication dates from
act dates, and stored subtitles from verified audio. Explain bounded parsing,
partial exports, uncertain coverage and refusal of ambiguous formats.

Sovereignty impact: Keep acquisition separately selected and all supplied-export
analysis local, portable and independent of a provider or model.

Validation: Source and package documentation checks accompany the local tests.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.2.0.0 - 2026-10-25

Summary: Document schema 4 investigation records and verified-copy upgrades,
phased planning, selected transactional installation and recovery, native agent
exports, PDF page citations, direct derived comparison and optional MCP methods.
Provide compact skill recipes and an independent SDK qualification runner.

Threat impact: Explain concurrency refusal, unknown source independence,
analyst-declared outcomes, recovery conflicts and bounded cancellable operations.
Keep historical observations separate from current checks and model findings.

Sovereignty impact: Retain local portable artifacts, explicit host capabilities
and independently chosen clients/models without mandatory remote services.

Validation: Public source/package links and dated observations are checked in
the local delivery workflow. General model quality remains unestablished.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.1.1.0 - 2026-10-25

Summary: Refresh the English README banner and align its recorded integrity hash
with the revised artwork.

Threat impact: Retain the synthetic promotional artwork label. The recorded hash
checks file integrity and does not establish authenticity.

Sovereignty impact: Keep the banner bundled locally without a runtime service
or provider dependency.

Validation: Banner visually inspected, PNG dimensions and recorded SHA-256 verified.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.

## 0.1.0.0 - 2026-10-18

Summary: Document prioritized case review, the optional MCP summary, the updated
private dashboard, and the observed checks and remaining compatibility limits.

Threat impact: Explain that review tasks require analyst verification and that
aggregate MCP output excludes evidence text, identifiers and private paths.

Sovereignty impact: Retain local workflows and distinguish local helper checks
from client/model trials and external transmission decisions.

Validation: Source and packaged documentation links were checked. Browser
evidence covers screenshots only; interactive behavior remains unverified.
Local commit status: `verification-pending` until complete pre-push checks pass.
